name: gate/decay tiles
sync: MTE3->V self-paired at the pass boundary

name: L masked
sync: launch order on the caller's stream

name: Rk, Rv
consumer: solve cube AIC (L0B) as the solve's right-hand sides

name: Decay
consumer: k2 AIV stage 4 (dequeue, one row per chunk)

name: Qn, Kn
producer: not written in production (pointers passed as null)

name: A16
consumer: solve assemble AIC + solve cube AIC (L0A)
sync: launch order on the caller's stream

name: Pmid
producer: solve assemble AIC Fixpipe (X21 = -X22 L21 X11)

name: W, U
producer: solve cube AIC (W = A_inv @ Rk, U = A_inv @ Rv)
consumer: k2 AIC stage 1 (qw) and AIV stage 2 (DataCopy ub)
sync: launch order on the caller's stream

name: st (resident state)
consumer: k2 AIV stage 4 + final S32 publish

name: d1/d1f/d2/d3/d3f/ob (UB)
sync: MTE2_V / V_MTE3, phase aliasing in the TBuf plan

name: lw/lg/ls/la/lv/lx/lk (L1)
producer: k2 AIC DataCopy (Nd2Nz, one per operand)
symbols: qw qg qs qa qv qx qk

name: S32 (fp32)
producer: k2 AIV, once at the end

name: Out (bf16)
producer: k2 AIV stage 4 (strided store, public layout)

name: Vnew (row-major)
producer: not written in production (null pointer, R3 guard)
